hero.title: Private Tutoring at Premier Academy
hero.lead: A highly personalized learning experience, tailored to each student’s individual academic needs.

intro.lead: Every tutoring plan starts with the student, not the syllabus.
intro.body: Our tutors undergo rigorous screening before they ever meet a student, and sessions can be held online from home using modern conferencing technology or in person at our San Gabriel campus.
intro.groups: Students who prefer to work alongside friends may form small groups of two or three for a more cost-efficient arrangement, without losing the individual attention that makes tutoring work.
